testDefinitions.notes: 50.0 mg in water to 250.0 mL; dilute 2.0 mL to 200.0 mL with 0.1 M HCl (total dilution: 250 x 200 / 2 = 25,000 mL). Measure specific absorbance at 264 nm. BP Appendix II B. Source: Potassium Sorbate__STM Potassium Sorbate.txt:30

1.0 g in 50 mL water, add 10 mL dilute HCl, filter crystalline precipitate, wash with water, dry in vacuo over sulfuric acid for 4 h, determine melting point of residue (132-136 °C). BP Appendix V A. Source: Potassium Sorbate__STM Potassium Sorbate.txt:30

0.2 g in 2 mL water + 2 mL dilute acetic acid, filter, add 1 mL freshly prepared 100 g/L sodium cobaltinitrite solution: yellow or orange-yellow precipitate forms immediately. BP Appendix VI. Source: Potassium Sorbate__STM Potassium Sorbate.txt:30

testDefinitions.displayName: Acidity or alkalinity of potassium sorbate
testDefinitions.notes: 20 mL solution S + 0.1 mL phenolphthalein solution, titrate with 0.1 M NaOH or 0.1 M HCl to colour change; mL volume result (NMT 0.25 mL) cannot be calculated by the titration workflow, analyst enters final mL value (CATALOG.md rule 6). BP Appendix V L. Source: Potassium Sorbate__STM Potassium Sorbate.txt:32

1.0 g in 30 mL water + 50 mL 2-propanol, pH 4 with 1 M HCl, to 100 mL; 10 mL + 1 mL decolorized fuchsin vs acetaldehyde standard (1.5 mL of 100 ppm, NMT 0.15% as acetaldehyde). Stand 30 min. Visual comparison. Source: Potassium Sorbate__STM Potassium Sorbate.txt:33

testDefinitions.notes: 0.1 g in 2 mL dilute HCl, effervescence of CO2, boil 1 min, add 10 mL water and 1 mL 6 N NH4OH, add 1 mL ammonium oxalate TS: white precipitate of calcium oxalate soluble in HCl and insoluble in acetic acid. USP monograph. Source: Calcium Carbonate__STM Calcium Carbonate - New.txt:32

5.0 g mixed with 10 mL water, add dilute HCl dropwise with agitation until effervescence ceases, add water to 200 mL, filter, wash residue chloride-free, ignite (600 +/- 50 C in 078), weigh residue. Shared between Calcium Carbonate STM-RM-078 and Calcium Carbonate DC STM-RM-142 (same procedure, CATALOG.md rule 2). testDefinitions.notes: 1.0 g in 5 mL water + 8 mL 3 N HCl, evaporate to dryness, dissolve in 5 mL water; citrate, hydroxylamine, ammonia, potassium cyanide, dithizone extraction; visual comparison vs 3 ug lead standard (NMT 3 ppm). USP <251>. Source: Calcium Carbonate__STM Calcium Carbonate - New.txt:35

1.0 g dissolved in 15 mL HCl to 55 mL vs 3.0 mL arsenic standard solution to 35 mL. KI, SnCl2, granular zinc in scrubber with lead acetate cotton into silver diethyldithiocarbamate TS (NMT 3 ppm). USP <211>. Source: Calcium Carbonate__STM Calcium Carbonate - New.txt:36

Platinum wire dipped in filtrate from acid-insoluble substances, held in non-luminous flame: no green colour imparted to flame. USP monograph. Source: Calcium Carbonate__STM Calcium Carbonate - New.txt:37

2.0 g in 20 mL water + 4.0 mL HCl, 50.0 mL sodium citrate solution A, to 100 mL. Fluoride ion-selective electrode calibrated with USP Sodium Fluoride RS standard additions (0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0 ug/mL vs mV). Result (NMT 50 ppm) cannot be calculated by standard workflows; analyst enters final ppm value (CATALOG.md rule 6). USP <591>. Source: Calcium Carbonate__STM Calcium Carbonate - New.txt:38

1.0 g sample in 35 mL water + 3 mL HCl, boil 1 min, rapidly add 40 mL oxalic acid TS, methyl red, 6 N NH4OH to alkaline, dilute to 100 mL, stand 4 h, filter. Evaporate 50 mL filtrate in platinum dish with 0.5 mL H2SO4, ignite to constant weight. Shared between STM-RM-078 and STM-RM-142 (same procedure, CATALOG.md rule 2). testDefinitions.notes: 0.150 g in 3 mL dilute HCl + 20 mL water, boil 2 min, dilute to 50 mL, add 6.0 mL strong NaOH and about 200 mg calconcarboxylic acid triturate; titrate with 0.1 M sodium edetate VS from violet to full blue. solutions.name: 0.05 M Edetate disodium VS
solutions.instructions: Dissolve 18.6 g of edetate disodium in water to make 1000 ml.
solutions.notes: Preparation and standardization stated: 18.6 g in water to 1000 mL. Standardized against about 200 mg chelometric standard calcium carbonate, dissolved in dilute HCl, pH 12-13, hydroxy naphthol blue indicator, titrated to blue endpoint. Equivalence: 1 mL 0.05 M EDTA = 5.0045 mg CaCO3 (100.09 x 0.05). House defaults: 3 replicates, factor 0.97-1.03, max RSD 0.2 %, validity 30 days, shelf life 30 days. Source: Calcium Carbonate__STM Calcium Carbonate - New.txt:28
